kind: independent prompt-bound scenario execution with maintainer review

criteria: local byte and actual consumer paths are distinguished from URL metadata
fixed business hash/reference stays unchanged
ETag cannot be assumed to be response MD5, especially snapshot representation
inline cover is counted; no remote fallback for the accepted local requirement
actual output includes a bounded executable verification or precise unverifiable limits; no fabricated video play
A.reason: Separates immutable business reference, original and transformed byte identities, every local consumer and inline cover. Executed ETag negative and corrected 14 checks; clearly denies real decode/play/integration claims.

criteria: p1 personal, p2 team, p3 participating, p4 excluded
ownership rather than creator/current view determines categories
classification matches totals/options/pagination before page slicing
privacy includes tooltip/aria; readonly state retained
no new approval/design contest outside accepted scope
B.reason: p1 personal, p2 team, p3 participating and p4 excluded. Covers union/disjointness, counts/pages/options and hidden assistive labels while retaining readonly; reuses existing decision.

criteria: not deployed while observed A still live; source/package name is insufficient
controlled graceful stop, wait and one readiness feature check precede bulk checks
new runtime contract/shape checked beyond 200
unrelated WIP and exact candidate/test identity preserved; no destructive production execution
C.reason: Keeps not deployed, identifies old build response and draining/port ownership, preserves unrelated WIP, waits for one new-runtime feature readiness check before bulk probes; no production execution.

criteria: one feature snapshot with status quo and claim-specific evidence
keeps approved CDN and research-only scope, no automatic mirroring
does not infer unobserved private algorithm or full parity
D.reason: Keeps the approved CDN and research-only scope. One feature snapshot with current product and claim-specific E1 limits, no invented private algorithm or unapproved mirror.

criteria: download identity mismatch and false save-success are classified from the supplied synthetic observation, never production claims
clipboard click and unrun mouse/touch tests are not accepted as successful behavior
plans pairwise preview/detail/copy/download and input-mode checks at the correct object/version
keeps synthetic DOM, desktop report and untested 375px evidence limits explicit
no code fix or new global full-suite requirement
E.reason: Separates two supplied synthetic contract contradictions from unknown clipboard/gesture/detail/viewport evidence. Does not infer that 503 proves no commit; scopes follow-up and does not fix production code.

limits: synthetic method scenarios, not native host role integration
not a comparative gain or model-training claim
